ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

be amended by changing all the B3-3 Community Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 2-1 in the area bounded by
a line 100 feet south of and parallel to West Congress Street; South
California Avenue; a line 125 feet south of and parallel to West Congress
Street; and the Public Alley next west of and parallel to South California

Avenue;

to those of a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 510 South California Avenue
